exact_current_source_matches.line: Setup validates production runtime only and must not require browser-certification packages or a free fixed port. `run_lab` owns its configured lab port. Full browser certification remains strict.
Run `python -m nicegui_base.validate <app-root>`. Errors must be fixed. Warnings should be fixed unless a documented escape hatch is justified. For stricter gates use `--warnings-as-errors`.
- User/settings menus must open visibly below the fixed header with viewport collision handling.
- toasts never collide with the fixed header.
